    local_tp_rank: int, local_tp_size: int, remote_tp_size: int
) -> int:
    """Map a local tensor-parallel rank to its corresponding remote TP rank.

    Producer and consumer TP sizes must be integer multiples of one another.
    When the local side has more ranks, several local ranks collapse onto a
    single remote rank; when the remote side has more ranks, the first rank of
    the owning remote group is returned.

    Args:
        local_tp_rank: The local tensor-parallel rank.
        local_tp_size: The local tensor-parallel world size.
        remote_tp_size: The remote tensor-parallel world size.

    Returns:
        The remote tensor-parallel rank this local rank communicates with.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the two TP sizes are not integer multiples.
    """
    if local_tp_size <= 0 or remote_tp_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "MoRIIO TP sizes must be positive: "
            f"local_tp_size={local_tp_size}, remote_tp_size={remote_tp_size}"

    if local_tp_size >= remote_tp_size:
        if local_tp_size % remote_tp_size != 0:
            raise ValueError(
